package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestLoadMigrationsUsesSortedForwardFilesOnly(t *testing.T) {
	directory := t.TempDir()
	for filename, contents := range map[string]string{
		"010_later.up.sql":   "SELECT 10;",
		"001_first.up.sql":   "SELECT 1;",
		"001_first.down.sql": "SELECT 0;",
		"notes.txt":          "ignore",
	} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, filename), []byte(contents), 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	migrations, err := LoadMigrations(directory)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(migrations) != 2 || migrations[0].Filename != "001_first.up.sql" || migrations[1].Filename != "010_later.up.sql" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected migrations: %#v", migrations)
	}
	if len(migrations[0].SHA256) != 64 || migrations[0].SHA256 == migrations[1].SHA256 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected checksums: %#v", migrations)
	}
}
